folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B343: entry, continuing self and actual means
folds.body:
All97 original lines were reviewed, including every built, briefed and researched world row, the system-level legend, cross-world conclusions and open list. Preserve this as the October10 proposal matrix with its explicit later You Are Summoned row. “Built” means the stated historical source-present/mostly-unverified scope, not current native readiness, full source qualification or ordinary-life coverage. The dated HP/LOTM placement and visitor descriptions cannot override subsequent lead-first developer routes, selected eras or current Klein/Harry priorities.

Source protagonist entry, the current visitor route, a candidate origin and a creation-screen metaphor are different columns. The source's first scene is not a mandatory player start or an occasion to reveal hidden mechanism/potential. WER2–WER9 and ST1–ST17 now own crossing method, era, body, knowledge, cargo, previous-life state and obligations. The matrix's early LOTM ritual/host summary is not complete later-source entry knowledge. Source persona, magic source, social status and first power cannot be automatically granted by a matching label or card. A proposed house/clan/aptitude screen needs its actual source and known-only projection.

The S0–S7 ladder is a comparison taxonomy, not a universal scalar of strength, jurisdiction, permission or insight. A world can lack a visible status system while containing powerful native mechanisms. Likewise broad loop/integration clusters suggest shared seams but do not make rewind, reset, branches, copies, clocks, sponsors or retention identical. AD51 favors actual common semantics and world-local differences. A source-defined flaw, feeding rule, price ratio, chronology or faculty restriction needs the pinned source/edition rather than a memory row; a public rating is not competence. The expanded You Are Summoned clocks/carry list remains its reported five-book reading scope, not newly reopened proof.

The claims that point-buy fits only selected worlds and genetics is the common stat system are illustrative, not global laws. Interface allocation can be a player authoring control, or a real diegetic operation when the premise supplies one. HP/Naruto/faculty inheritance need actual source mechanisms, not a universal genotype or probability model. An independent imported faculty may remain fully useful without forced conversion or a native-only advantage. Current AD52 preserves consequential choices and permits quiet complete pursuits. This read added no creation screen, source route, world/source fact, catalogue, implementation gate or new source reading; useful row ideas and historical qualifications remain intact.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B343: entry, continuing self and actual means
folds.body:
All118 original lines were reviewed, including all origin axes, ten scenario families, retention examples, family/child/tree policies, calendar model, worked arc, engineering limits and the later finite Paradise-entry outcome. Preserve coherent combinations over unrestricted label products, and actual differences among body, controller, prior memory, faculty, learned method, resources, social recognition and office. A child, plant, beast, projection or ordinary adult needs useful supported actions, not merely a cosmetic starting tag.

The earlier no-predecessor-power default is qualified by the chosen premise and actual retained anatomy/source. An origin can inherit power, mastery or gear where a real carrier provides it; the examples' mandatory cost, enemies, attention or smaller budget are proposals, not taxes on every advanced host. Reincarnating into an infant does not automatically import an adult physique, while a genuine faculty may directly supply unusual control. A new body need not lose its operative organ just to create challenge. Current WER/ST inherited-host guidance further separates death cause, arrival, body viability, continuing contamination and identity-bound work.

Generated household wealth, affection, custody, language, potential and obligations remain distinct. Parents/guardians need not know private memories automatically. Household stock is not duplicated player property by virtue of kinship. The seed and pool/revision record stabilizes the selected circumstance only with its actual generator/content and saved result. Explicitly starting a new life can have a declared reroll policy; no anti-cheat penalty follows. Private real-person details are not populated from unrelated user context without supplied characterization.

Chapter advancement can compress days/years under AD52 while preserving meaningful choices, real support/costs, causal events and observer knowledge. It cannot silently credit unperformed mastery, paid work or actual decisions the player never chose. Active/away/paused clocks and former body awareness/autonomy require their actual continuation contracts; no blanket browser-closed aging/starvation or simultaneous autonomous life is selected by this palette. Distinct local calendars can share a scheduler while retaining different rates and instances, without merging worlds because their dates match.

Tree roots, senses, vessels, seeds, avatars and groves are useful distinct scopes. Growth outputs require their actual mechanism; a seed is not automatic duplication of all consciousness, source and belongings, but an actual duplication/transmission mechanism may provide more. A caretaker's or carrier's independent agency remains meaningful. A strong power can solve movement, watering or communication without forced residual chores. Actual geometry matters only where reach/access changes a selected consumer.

The old HP outside-completed-dossiers and origin-selection/body/menu absence claims are dated source observations. The later independent Paradise entry deliberately scopes one retained human/Goa route and original timing terms; it does not implement infancy, family generation or protagonist replacement, and it does not newly establish current gameplay/save acceptance here. Its old current/deferred labels remain bounded to that receipt. Current LOTM-first/Harry developer direction replaces any implicit old startup order, and AD51 supports a first useful seam. Generic human review is optional under AD42; real entry/persistence/native gaps remain to be verified for a selected origin. No source, personal data, clock, origin initializer, migration, worker or gameplay behavior was changed by this review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B343: entry, continuing self and actual means
folds.body:
All245 original lines were reviewed, including the model menu, OD6 uptake, knowledge/control questions, K1–K10, all lore explanations, literal-self implications and the final embodiment/return reconciliation. Later OD6 and the October15 embodiment/return entries qualify the earlier O1-within/O8-between recommendation and stale “not accepted a universal lore model” decision-status sentence. One continuing self is the accepted default in the linked direction, while a universal soul substance, compulsory possession, independent mind copies, memory-sharing formula and other detailed metaphysics are not selected (AD32). Preserve the earlier recommendation as chronology rather than treating it as current independent-lives default.

The useful axes remain goal, knowledge, belief, control, experience and continuation. Interface viewpoint, convenient controls and first-person prose do not prove an extra spirit or supernatural insight. A source can genuinely advise, compel, supply facts or transfer mastery only through its actual channel; an advertised independent host can refuse where the chosen control contract permits it. Ordinary direct-control choices should not be vetoed by random temperament, automatic madness or a forced metaphysical explanation. A character can know more than the human, and reminders/routines can express that competence without demanding trivia or manual replay.

Keep human action choice distinct from factual claims granted to a character. A player can inspect a likely place, guess a password, form a hunch or distrust an actor without the game policing the private reason. That does not prefill unknown secrets, create a learning/source faculty or make an allegation persuasive to others. Accurate prior-story knowledge refers to its edition/history; intervention can change relevant causes, without secretly randomizing the world to punish familiarity. A perfect information power can bypass uncertainty where its actual scope supports it. Confidence, truth, comprehension, credibility and communicated proof remain different consequences.

The final return clarification already distinguishes a paused embodiment, dead body, sustained vessel, independent person and chronicle-only record. Survival alone does not grant consciousness/autonomy or a second base cheat; returning bodily, resuming a paused self and rewinding history are different operations. Existing support/means determine CA14 access and suppression, without universal ordinary-body action or relocation. An actual continuing relationship can survive its declared mechanism, rather than being erased for difficulty or imposed on an unrelated new person. Affection, recognition, bodily familiarity and legal claims retain their actual owners.

The literal-self section correctly avoids importing actual private relationships, credentials or biography. The fiction can use an abstract/supplied self without treating closing the app as a physical return or asserting changes to the human's real body. Copy/merge, several vessels and years of experience can have different actual continuation terms; the game need not solve every philosophical question or add automatic trauma/homesickness/synchronization meters. A mystery about origin can coexist with clear controls and known stakes, and does not authorize retroactively rewriting earned history.

K8's practical intention contract and current AD52 preserve actual actor, authorized spend/methods, stock/custody, report and stopping policy through delegation. Ordinary supported work can proceed quietly; materially new consequential choices use the actual chosen decision-maker. A narrower UI view must not erase a richer supported routine or imply that its executor no longer exists. Current AD51 favors useful existing seams rather than a universal mind/knowledge/control engine.

The original save-and-commit instruction is historical authorization for that conversation's notes, not a current commit grant. This task preserves its no-commit/no-push boundary. All old whitespace/source/runtime check statements remain dated evidence; no new knowledge gate, identity model, migration, controlled body, outside-information channel, source proof, secret disclosure or gameplay verification was implemented here. The specific accepted direction stays in its existing authority owners; all unselected models/variants remain available as proposals.
